Usage: omp-kit [GLOBAL FLAGS] [COMMAND] [FLAGS]
Bare invocation inspects kit and OMP presence; it never applies rules or modifies profiles.
Commands:

Usage: omp-kit rch lease [FLAGS] -- COMMAND [ARG ...]

Native remote-build lifecycle; no replacement daemon or cache policy

Usage: omp-kit rch lease --slots N [--worker ID] [--project PATH] [--plan | --apply --yes] -- COMMAND [ARG ...]

Observe, reclaim under native policy, admit, execute and verify next-agent readiness

Usage: omp-kit heavy [--label LABEL] [--no-wait] [--max-runtime SECONDS] [--disk-observer statfs|sbh|auto] -- COMMAND [ARG ...]

Run one load- and disk-admitted command at nice 10; exit 75 when admission is deferred (queue wait max_wait_s), 124 when the admitted child outruns its runtime budget, 69 when no disk observer is available (load.json disk_observer sbh|statfs|auto, optional disk_floor_pct)

Usage: omp-kit converge --repo PATH [--apply] [--push] [--no-fetch] [--ours PATH]... [--theirs PATH]...

Report or owner-resolve shared-main convergence without overwriting peer state

Usage: omp-kit land --paths PATH... --message MSG --apply --yes | land --patch FILE --message MSG --apply --yes

Commit exactly reserved paths to shared main and publish through owner-resolved convergence

Usage: omp-kit status

Inspect kit and OMP presence without changing configuration

Usage: omp-kit lessons add --class CLASS --what TEXT --evidence TEXT [--kind LESSON|GAP|NEGATIVE|CORRECTION] [--superseded-by ID|DOC] [--corrects ID] [--applies-to repo|fleet] [--project PATH] [--commit --bead ID]

Append evidence-backed lessons or corrections without rewriting history

Usage: omp-kit fleet-lessons [--project PATH]... [--json]

Read current lesson advice, preserved history and unresolved references; never runs intake, classification or services

Usage: omp-kit intake --from joshua --text TEXT --seat SEAT [--kind rule|work]

Record one request from Joshua, resolve the receiving seat's role, print DO or ROUTE <bead> -> <seat>

Usage: omp-kit checkin [--done TEXT]... [--blocked TEXT]... [--next TEXT]... [--project PATH] [--commit --bead ID]

Record verified own activity or explicit completed, blocked and next items

Usage: omp-kit planning score|convert

Score planning evidence or convert a plan into native beads in an isolated database or selected tracker

Usage: omp-kit mission validate|anchor [--project PATH] [--json]

Validate the local Mission Protocol record without running its checks

Usage: omp-kit drain close-queue|stale-claims --db PATH [--repo DIR] [--json]

List landed-but-open beads and stale in-progress claims from a tracker

Usage: omp-kit drain stale-claims --db PATH [--json]

In-progress/rework beads untouched 24 h whose holder is not live (seat, Agent Mail activity, live reservation), each with one atomic reclaim; unreadable liveness lists the row UNKNOWN

Usage: omp-kit load watch

Inspect machine load attribution or run the opt-in census watcher

Usage: omp-kit doctor [--scope COMPONENT] [--project PATH --file PATH] [--profile NAME] [--sources] [--services PATH] [--staged] [--deep --yes]

Diagnose installed components (deeper probe needs separate consent)

Usage: omp-kit health

Strict monitoring status

Usage: omp-kit corpus --sessions ABS_DIR [--out ABS_FILE] [--plan]

Report per-rule fire rates over local OMP session transcripts; never uploads

Usage: omp-kit lsp setup --plan

Inspect installed OMP language-server readiness without starting servers

Usage: omp-kit memory audit --store-root PATH --yes

Separately consented, local covered-class audit of a selected Mnemopi store root

Usage: omp-kit tern catalog|doctor|ctl|script|native|api|sdk|coverage|surface|render

Source-bound native Tern SDK and control integration

Usage: omp-kit tern native [FLAGS]

Run documented native CLI argv (plugin, browser, shot, serve, ctl, help)

Usage: omp-kit tern native [FLAGS]

Run documented native CLI argv (plugin, browser, shot, serve, ctl, help)

Usage: omp-kit tern ctl [FLAGS]

Forward an exact native command, preserving control/scenario grammar

Build, query, validate, or drift-check the version-pinned local Tern Plugin SDK reference

Usage: omp-kit tern-ref build [--root DIR] [--site URL] [--force]

Crawl docs, chunk tern.d.luau per member, index nomic+qwen, and write the version-keyed manifest

Usage: omp-kit tern-ref drift [--root DIR] [--site URL]

Re-crawl, re-index on ETag or version change, and list beads citing changed chunks

Usage: omp-kit test [--project PATH] [--full] [--record] [--capabilities ABS_JSON] | [--rules ABS_DIR --cases ABS_FILE [--live-fixture ABS_JSON]] | [--integrations [--profile A,B] [--plan] [--out ABS_FILE] [--keep]] | [--mcp --profiles all|A,B [--servers A,B] [--call SERVER:TOOL:JSON [--expect SERVER:REGEX]]... [--startup-timeout-ms N] [--call-timeout-ms N]] | [--metamorphic [--rules ABS_DIR --cases ABS_FILE]] | [--mutants [--mutant-budget-secs N] [--rules ABS_DIR --cases ABS_FILE]] | [--repeat N [--scenario ID] [--baseline ABS_JSON]]

Run bundled matcher conformance, external G1-G3 packs, a public-synthetic external G4 marker fixture, a required-capability check, per-profile integration proof, per-profile MCP callable proof, strict zero-break metamorphic relations, mutation adequacy, or repeat flake verdicts

Usage: omp-kit review rules|reduce

Compare authored rules or reduce a public-synthetic native false fire

Usage: omp-kit update [--plan|--apply] --version X.Y.Z --index PATH --archive PATH | update --reconcile RECEIPT --yes

Preview or guardedly update the kit; OMP updates are managed externally

Usage: omp-kit apply rules|policy|extensions|plugin|mcp [--plan|--apply]

Plan or apply a named kit component

Usage: omp-kit apply mcp --from claude|cursor|codex|project|ABS_PATH --servers NAMES|all --profiles NAMES|all [--plan|--apply --yes] [--startup-timeout-ms N|NAME=N,...] [--override NAME=ABS_JSON]... [--env-literal NAMES] | apply mcp --profiles NAMES|all [--env-command SERVER:KEY=!CMD]... [--enable NAMES] [--timeout-ms NAME=N,...] [--plan|--apply --yes]

Import MCP servers from another harness config into OMP profiles' mcp.json, or edit servers already there (env !command values, re-enable, timeouts), with a receipt and undo; interactive on a terminal without --servers/--profiles

[--env-literal NAMES] | apply mcp --profiles NAMES|all [--env-command SERVER:KEY=!CMD]... [--enable NAMES] [--timeout-ms NAME=N,...] [--plan|--apply --yes]

Usage: omp-kit repair --scope rules|policy|extensions|state|github [--plan|--apply --yes]

Plan a named reversible repair

Usage: omp-kit migrate [--plan|--apply --yes]

Move legacy ~/.agents/rules kit copies to native plugin layering; edited copies are kept and flagged for overlay

Usage: omp-kit undo RUN_ID [--yes]

Guardedly restore one verified receipt

Usage: omp-kit audit

Inspect receipt chronology

Usage: omp-kit why RUN_ID

Explain one recorded run

Usage: omp-kit quickstart

Safe first commands and their limits

Usage: omp-kit examples [memory-off|mnemopi-manual|model-roles|mcp|omp-watch|skill-set --from-history DAYS [--profile NAME]]

Read-only examples and versioned profile recipes; never activates a profile

Usage: omp-kit service list|install|uninstall|status|doctor|logs|run

Manage operator service jobs (launchd/systemd); reads foreign jobs, never rewrites them

Usage: omp-kit service install JOB [--dry-run] [--plan] [--apply --yes] [--replace]

Install a job: render, diff, backup, bootstrap, verify; refuses a label loaded from a different plist unless --replace

Usage: omp-kit send SESSION PANE MESSAGE

Send a message to a fleet pane and prove it landed (marker poll up to 15 s, one retry, drop-folder fallback; tern:<id> panes use native Tern delivery through the window's control endpoint)

Usage: omp-kit fleet flush-pending [--apply --yes]

Act on the live tmux fleet

Usage: omp-kit fleet flush-pending [--apply --yes]

Find idle omp panes holding a queued band or composer text, and turns showing a band for 5+ min or frozen (spinner over an unchanged screen). Plan by default; --apply only sends Alt+Up then Enter to an idle pane whose queued band sits over an empty composer; everything else, busy and frozen panes included, is reported and never sent keys

Usage: omp-kit fleet respawn [--panes SESSION:W.P,...] [--apply --yes]

Report panes running a stale plugin (omp started before the latest applied relink); with --panes and --apply --yes, respawn named idle panes with --resume, strictly serially. Busy, frozen, dirty, reservation-holding and sessionless panes are reported, never touched

Usage: omp-kit fleet respawn [--panes SESSION:W.P,...] [--apply --yes]

Report panes running a stale plugin (omp started before the latest applied relink); with --panes and --apply --yes, respawn named idle panes with --resume, strictly serially. Busy, frozen, dirty, reservation-holding and sessionless panes are reported, never touched

Usage: omp-kit sha SHA [--repo PATH]...

Resolve a commit sha across every fleet repo (kit, companion, ~/.claude, project repos) and report which repos hold it

Usage: omp-kit sha SHA [--repo PATH]...

Resolve a commit sha across every fleet repo (kit, companion, ~/.claude, project repos) and report which repos hold it

Usage: omp-kit custody check --repo PATH [--agent NAME] [--reserve [--ttl SECONDS] [--reason TEXT]] PATH

Answer 'may I edit this path' from git and reservations via the fleet custody probe; one PATH per call

Usage: omp-kit intake --from joshua --text TEXT --seat SEAT [--kind rule|work]

Record one request from Joshua, resolve the receiving seat's role, print DO or ROUTE <bead> -> <seat>

Usage: omp-kit infra pin|check|promote|undo

Pin, check and promote the toolchain the gates run on (test before upgrade, human promotes)

Usage: omp-kit scratch plan|release DIR|use DIR|unuse DIR|mine|new|apply|gate --at POINT [--apply --yes]

Release finished owned task scratch; reap dead owned sessions, quarantine released or idle unowned entries, delete expired quarantine. Unowned-active rule: unowned dir with newest mtime in tree within 72h (12h while its disk is at RECLAIM pressure, free <= 20%) is LIVE unowned-but-active; idle past that with no open fds goes to quarantine. Plan and apply JSON include per-row sizes, per-root/per-verdict totals, malformed-owner counts and the exact policy; apply also includes a reaper receipt.

Usage: omp-kit scratch use DIR [--pid PID]

Register a process as a user of one owned scratch dir (its TMPDIR or work storage): records its incarnation (pid and process start) in DIR/.users under a private lock with an atomic rewrite, pruning dead, reused and zombie records. While any registered user probes live or unknown, release --now refuses USER_LIVE and apply keeps the dir (LIVE user-live), even with no file open. Liveness evidence only: it grants no authority to release

Usage: omp-kit scratch release DIR [--bin throwaway|evidence|promote [--ref file:PATH|bead:ID]] [--now] [--capability TOKEN] [--legacy-owner --reason TEXT --yes]

Mark one finished task directory for quarantine. Authority is the owning seat (agent and omp session), the capability `scratch new` returned (--capability or OMP_KIT_SCRATCH_CAPABILITY), or the directory's owning process or a child of it. Legacy ownership formats require the explicit operator request --legacy-owner --reason TEXT --yes; root, unchanged-owner and open-file checks still apply. --bin records where the content went: throwaway needs no reference, evidence and promote need --ref to a bead or a committed and pushed file that proves the content arrived (cites the directory's scratch-sha256 token, or a file is a byte-identical copy). With --now the directory is retired in the same turn

Usage: omp-kit scratch apply [--apply --yes [--file-gaps [--db PATH]]]

Apply the guarded plan, delete expired quarantine, then kill orphaned harness servers; the JSON response repeats the policy and totals and includes the reaper receipt and the gap report. With --file-gaps, guarded gap classes are filed to their owning beads (one br comment per bead, only dirs no earlier run filed)

Usage: omp-kit scratch release DIR [--bin throwaway|evidence|promote [--ref file:PATH|bead:ID]] [--now] [--capability TOKEN] [--legacy-owner --reason TEXT --yes]

Usage: omp-kit scratch new --label LABEL [--bead ID] [--export COMMIT]

Create one owned task scratch dir with a JSON .owner and print its path plus a release capability (data.capability, 256 random bits returned only here; .owner keeps its sha256, never the token). Keep the capability: `scratch release DIR --capability TOKEN` releases the dir from any later process, whatever its seat or pid; the only writer agents use

Usage: omp-kit scratch mine [--at review|close|session-end]

Read-only unless --at is given

Usage: omp-kit scratch gate --at review|close|wave|push|session-end

Enforcement at a disposal point: refuse (exit 1, SCRATCH_OWED) while the session holds an undisposed dir; fail-open (UNPROVEN, exit 0) when the ownership census cannot be listed
